parties: Godawari Power and Ispat Limited (GPIL); N P Agrawal
headline: GPIL Acquisition Disclosure Under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Godawari Power and Ispat Limited disclosed an acquisition of shares in reliance on a Regulation 10 exemption under the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011. N P Agrawal submitted the disclosure to the NSE on 19 August 2026.
implication: Regulation 10 exemptions under SAST allow acquisitions below the 25% triggering threshold (or other carve-outs) without triggering mandatory open offer requirements; this disclosure signals compliance with the exemption reporting obligation rather than a full takeover event.
detail: N P Agrawal filed a Regulation 10(6) report with the NSE confirming that an acquisition was made in reliance upon an exemption provided under Regulation 10 of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The specific exemption category, number of shares acquired, consideration, and identity of the target are not disclosed in the headline filing summary. This is a compliance filing confirming exemption-based acquisition rather than a conventional open offer.
